hypotheses.L0_full_recurrence_is_exact: The all-block recurrence matches direct gradients at every site with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.L1_four_block_attention_window_is_suffic: At least one four-block contiguous end window reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and mean finite shift at least 80% of exact.
hypotheses.L2_eight_block_attention_window_is_suffi: At least one eight-block contiguous end window reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and mean finite shift at least 80% of exact.
hypotheses.L3_one_attention_block_is_sufficient: At least one single attention block reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.L4_one_attention_block_is_decisive: Removing one block from the full recurrence reduces median gradient cosine by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.L5_both_ends_beat_either_four_block_end: Enabling the four source-near and four logit-near blocks improves median cosine by at least 0.10 over the better four-block end window.
hypotheses.L6_mlp_only_retains_causal_direction: The MLP-only top-64 coalition has positive finite semantic effect at at least 90% of sites.
